notablePrerequisites:
Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}, searching for all lands in your library, exiling them and shuffling your library.
Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, causing you to mill your entire library.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
